notes.title: Updates
notes.content:
We have a long way to go, but thanks for getting me here! 1st update is a huge milestone that addresses not only some launch bugs, but also some user feedback on the difficulty to seduce the Mistress!

[b]Bugs addressed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Settings not always applying.
[*] Aria’s mouth interactions toggling when changing positions.
[*] “Ride” interaction is no longer hidden after changing positions.
[*] Fixed Aria rolling off the bed when she moans too hard. 
[/list]
[b]User Feedback addressed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Player can now touch Aria’s breasts if her mood is “Flirty” or higher without rejection.
[*] Player can now touch Aria’s butt if her mood is “Flirty” or higher without rejection.
[*] Player can now reset the interaction scene to replay the dialog at any time.
[/list]

Want to have your voice heard in the next update? Join the discord to submit issues and vote on new features! [url=https://discord.gg/cqWjnhrkUy]https://discord.gg/cqWjnhrkUy[/url]
